s1.syndrome_frame: Pituitary dysfunction with visual and neurological deficits
salient_findings: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass
key_facts: 2-month history of bitemporal hemianopia and left labial numbness
Right abducens nerve palsy on examination
Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling of the pituitary body and stalk
7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe on pituitary MRI
Loss of the posterior pituitary bright spot on T1-weighted images

raw.syndrome_frame: Pituitary dysfunction with visual and neurological deficits
salient_findings: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass
key_facts: 2-month history of bitemporal hemianopia and left labial numbness
Right abducens nerve palsy on examination
Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling of the pituitary body and stalk
7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe on pituitary MRI
Loss of the posterior pituitary bright spot on T1-weighted images

differentials: Langerhans cell histiocytosis with pituitary involvement
Langherans cell histiocytosis with IgG4-related disease overlap
Spindle cell oncocytoma of the pituitary
Granular cell tumor of the pituitary
Chordoid glioma of the third ventricle
Solitary fibrous tumor of the pituitary
Colloid cyst of the third ventricle
per_call: Langerhans cell histiocytosis with pituitary involvement
Langherans cell histiocytosis with IgG4-related disease overlap
Spindle cell oncocytoma of the pituitary
Granular cell tumor of the pituitary
Chordoid glioma of the third ventricle
Solitary fibrous tumor of the pituitary

shortlist.label: IgG4-related hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated serum IgG4 and pituitary MRI findings consistent with hypophysitis

shortlist.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary dysfunction and inflammation suggested by laboratory and imaging findings

shortlist.label: Granulomatous hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass, consistent with granulomatous inflammation

shortlist.label: Pituitary adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: 7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe on pituitary MRI, potentially causing hypopituitarism

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated IgG4 and granulomatous inflammation suggested by pituitary MRI, with potential for systemic involvement

raw.rationale: Elevated serum IgG4 and pituitary MRI findings consistent with hypophysitis, along with systemic findings suggestive of IgG4-related disease

rejected.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
rejected.why: Lack of specific markers or findings unique to lymphocytic hypophysitis

rejected.label: Granulomatous hypophysitis
rejected.why: No granulomatous changes mentioned in imaging or laboratory findings

rejected.label: Pituitary adenoma
rejected.why: MRI findings of diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass are not typical for a pituitary adenoma

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: No other organ involvement typical of sarcoidosis, and lack of granulomatous changes on imaging
